name: Rock Art of the Mediterranean Basin on the Iberian Peninsula
description: Scattered across eastern Spain, more than 700 rock shelters hold small painted scenes of hunters, archers, dancers and animals, made thousands of years ago in the Stone Age. Many sit inland in Aragon and Castilla–La Mancha rather than on the coast. Together they form Europe's largest concentration of such art, giving a lively glimpse of daily life in prehistoric times.
